cards.example_en: It was a difficult decision to make.
cards.example_zh: 那是一个非常艰难的决定。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：正式的
cards.example_en: He wore a formal suit to his sister's graduation dinner.
cards.example_zh: 他穿了一套正式西装去参加姐姐的毕业晚宴。

cards.example_en: People across the nation watched the final on television.
cards.example_zh: 全国各地的人都在电视上看了决赛。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：成功地
cards.example_en: He successfully climbed to the top of the hill.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：被逗乐的
cards.example_en: The toddlers were amused by the puppet show in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 大厅里的木偶戏把幼儿们逗乐了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：已婚的
cards.example_en: My uncle is married and lives with my aunt.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔已经结婚了，和我阿姨住在一起。

cards.example_en: Advertising on the school website brought more visitors.
cards.example_zh: 学校网站上登的广告带来了更多访问者。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：工程学
cards.example_en: She chose engineering because she likes designing stronger bridges.
cards.example_zh: 她选了工程学，因为她喜欢设计更结实的桥。

cards.example_en: Swimming before breakfast wakes me up completely.
cards.example_zh: 早饭前游泳能让我完全清醒过来。

cards.example_en: Football training starts on the field after school today.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练今天下课后在球场开始。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：可持续的
cards.example_en: Sustainable farming uses less water and fewer chemicals.
cards.example_zh: 可持续的耕作方式用水更少，化学品也更少。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：电气的
cards.example_en: An electrical fault shut the lights off during the play.
cards.example_zh: 一次电气故障让演出中途灯灭了。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：最后的
cards.example_en: The final whistle brought a huge cheer from the stands.
cards.example_zh: 终场哨声引来看台上巨大的欢呼。

cards.example_en: The butcher cut the meat for our family dinner.
cards.example_zh: 屠夫为我们的家庭晚餐切好了肉。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：更远；进一步
cards.example_en: Let's walk a bit further to the lake.
cards.example_zh: 让我们步行更远一点到湖边。
